reasoning_depth.evidence_weighting: Image brightness and low-bright share changes drive the visual dryness component, Open-Meteo dryness supports persistence, and GPM/CHIRPS plus receptor density provide context.
reasoning_depth.counterfactual_rejection: A burn-scar-confirmation reading fails because the dNBR pre/post counts are zero and the burn gate is only a scoring condition, not mapped burn severity.
reasoning_depth.uncertainty_or_scale_caveat: Masked AOI, OSM, and population products are authoritative for derived density statistics but not for judging absolute place metadata.

event.name: 2015 Indonesian drought, peat fires and transboundary haze

criteria.name: Image metrics
criteria.description: Computes all-pixel brightness means, low-bright shares, and deltas with the requested rounding.

criteria.name: Daily precipitation ledger
criteria.description: Uses the shared 2015-09-01 to 2015-10-16 weather-analysis window to compute dry count, dry share, longest run, and total point precipitation.

criteria.name: Cross-product precipitation arithmetic
criteria.description: Computes GPM-CHIRPS mean gap and ratio from structured precipitation products.

criteria.name: dNBR count gate
criteria.description: Applies the burn gate exactly from Sentinel-2 dNBR pre/post scene counts.

criteria.name: AOI and receptor densities
criteria.description: Computes compact AOI area and derives population and OSM element densities from masked authoritative product statistics.

criteria.name: Final formula and rounding
criteria.description: Applies the final weighted index formula and returns the requested JSON schema. Full credit also requires the `reasoning_depth` object to identify decisive evidence, reject the main tempting simplification, and state a bounded uncertainty or scale caveat.
